verdict.rationale: Org-wide policy enforcement is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack documents no admin console or team policy controls. App protection (TouchID/PIN/passwords) and 'disable future installations' are per-user settings in the individual's own app, not policies an IT admin pushes to every member. The lack of export is a product limitation, not an admin-enforced restriction.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app
